mapper.select: SELECT rock_group, characteristics, project_name FROM data_engineering_geology WHERE ST_Intersects( geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}, #{lat}), 4326) ) limit 1;

SELECT aquifer_rock, aquifer_type, water_abundance, rock_group_era, distribution_pos, burial_conditions FROM data_hydro_geology WHERE ST_Intersects( geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}, #{lat}), 4326) ) limit 1;

SELECT code, label, stratum_era, stratum_system, stratum_series, stratum_member, description, stratum_group, lithology FROM data_stratum WHERE ST_Intersects( geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}, #{lat}), 4326) ) limit 1;
SELECT province, city, county, street, village FROM data_ad_region WHERE level = 5 AND ST_Intersects( geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}, #{lat}), 4326) ) LIMIT 1;
